source._comment: Colorado SoS posts a daily 'General Election Activity' XLSX (ballots returned by county, party, age, gender) as press-release attachments during the election: https://www.coloradosos.gov/pubs/newsRoom/<YYYYMMDD>GeneralElectionActivity.xlsx (date = data-as-of day; posted each weekday once ballots mail ~Oct 13 2026). Files are SEASONAL (removed off-season) so there is nothing to validate against now: this reads 0 until the first 2026 file appears (discovered by probing recent weekdays). PENDING VERIFICATION of the exact sheet/column layout against the first live 2026 file (the Friday rollout routine confirms it). CO is all-mail: 'cast' = ballots returned.
